name: @sparx/marketplace-schemas
description: sparx Marketplace — Zod schemas + DTO contract for the data-driven, dual-app catalog (docs/60). The normalized MarketplaceListing the browse/detail UI renders, the faceted list response, the browse query, and the publisher + status enums. Zod-only (no DB, no React) so api-rest, the @sparx/db seed, the dashboard, and apps/web can all import it.
